'''Quatin''' was the fifth [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Orbit/Legends|orbiting]] the [[Star/Legends|star]] [[Bright Jewel/Legends|Bright Jewel]] in the [[Bright Jewel system/Legends|Bright Jewel system]],<ref name="EA" /> located in the [[Bright Jewel sector/Legends|Bright Jewel sector]]<ref name="EAOC" /> within the [[New Territories/Legends|New Territories]]<ref name="Region" /> of the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]].<ref name="EAOC" /> Quatin had fourty [[Moon/Legends|moons]] and was one of the three [[Gas giant/Legends|gas giants]] in the system.<ref name="EA" />

==Behind the scenes==
The [[Hologram/Legends|holographic]] model of the [[Bright Jewel system/Legends|Bright Jewel system]], showing the orbits of its planets, first appeared in a [[The Holonet|promotional web feature]] for the [[2011]] game ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' prior to its release.<ref name="HOR">{{HolonetOld|planets|ord-mantell|Ord Mantell}}</ref> Later, all worlds in the Bright Jewel system, except [[Ord Mantell/Legends|Ord Mantell]], were named in the [[2009]] sourcebook ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', co-authored by [[Jason Fry]] and [[Daniel Wallace]].<ref name="EA" />
